flags.title: Size it — don't fall in love
flags.note: Even a clean BUY deserves a position cap and an exit plan. Concentrated conviction (loyalty to one name) is how good theses become big drawdowns.
flags.lesson: Amazon: a great company held with no diversification became the biggest single loss.

strengths.point: Capital efficiency is high - the business earns well above a normal cost of capital.
Shareholder capital is compounding at a high rate.
Profit compounding has been strong over five years.
The balance sheet is effectively debt-free.
Reported profit is fully backed by operating cash.
The DCF puts intrinsic value well above the market price.
strengths.evidence: DCF intrinsic 4,208 vs price 2,823 - margin of safety 32.9%
Technical score 100/100 - RS rating 94 (market-beating); above 200-DMA; golden cross (50>200)

strengths.point: Sales has compounded at a decent five-year clip.
The sales trend has been rising for 4 years in a row.
The reserves trend has been rising for 9 years in a row.
The capex cycle has been completed - work-in-progress has been capitalised.
strengths.evidence: CWIP 221 Cr -> 12 Cr (-94.6%) as of Sep 2026

weaknesses.point: Cash stays locked in the working-capital cycle for a long time.
Return on capital has been eroding over recent years.
P/B is expensive against the sector median.
EV/EBITDA is expensive against the sector median.
Institutional money has been flowing out.
weaknesses.evidence: NEGATIVE MONEY FLOW - institutional holding change -1.35 pp

weaknesses.point: Margins contracted in the latest quarter.
weaknesses.evidence: Operating margin change -2 pp in the latest quarter

weaknesses.point: Inventory days are on the higher side.
Working capital intensity is on the higher side.
Domestic institutions have been cutting their stake.
Earnings follow a seasonal cycle rather than a steady line.
weaknesses.evidence: CYCLICAL - strong: Sep; weak: Mar, Jun, Dec

weaknesses.point: Profit slipped versus the previous quarter.

opportunities.point: Buying below the model's intrinsic value leaves room for a re-rating.
opportunities.evidence: DCF intrinsic 4,208 vs price 2,823 - margin of safety 32.9%

opportunities.point: The third plant is expected to generate around INR250 crores to INR300 crores in revenue.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "I think based on the value of what you were saying, around INR250 crores to INR300 crores, it would be easily achieved from the third plant." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: Sustainable EBITDA margins are expected to remain in the 19% to 20% plus range even after the new capex starts.
opportunities.evidence: Management guidance: "So, we can expect the similar kind of margins 19%, 20% plus." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: The new plant will commence commercial production by the first week of September 2026.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Commercial production would be 1st of September, first week of September." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: Dry run trials for the new plant are currently ongoing.
opportunities.evidence: Capex / expansion plan: "Dry run, dry run trial is already going on." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: Commissioned capacity should start contributing to revenue.
opportunities.evidence: CWIP 221 Cr -> 12 Cr (-94.6%) as of Sep 2026

opportunities.point: The price embeds less growth than the company has actually delivered.
opportunities.evidence: Reverse DCF implies 12.5% earnings growth vs 22% delivered over 5 years

opportunities.point: Europe is performing well, and positive growth is also seen in the APAC region and Middle East.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "And definitely Europe is our most Europe is doing good. Further ahead I think APAC region and Middle East. So, I think to be honest it's going positive for us in the export market." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: Management highlighted rapid advancement in expansion to meet increasing market demand.
opportunities.evidence: Demand outlook: "The rapid advancement in expansion highlights Stylam's commitment to enhancing production capacity and meeting increasing market demand." (concall ppt - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: Stylam operates an annual production capacity of approximately 20 million laminate sheets.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Annual production capacity of approximately 20 million laminate sheets." (concall ppt - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: Stylam sold 3.17 million sheets during Q1 FY27 compared to 3.27 million sheets in Q4 FY26.
opportunities.evidence: Orders / capacity: "Company has sold 3.17 Mn Sheets during the Q1 FY27 (Domestic - 1.10 Mn & Export 2.07 Mn) as compared to 3.27 Mn Sheets in Q4 FY26 (Domestic - 1.06 Mn & Export 2.21 Mn)." (concall ppt - 2026-07-01)

opportunities.point: Domestic market restructuring results and significant volume ramp-up will be visible from Q3 onwards.
opportunities.evidence: Management commitment: "And you will definitely see the results from Quarter 3. I won't even say Quarter 2, but you will see the results from Quarter 3 onwards." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01) [Q3 FY27]

threats.point: The stock has drawn down sharply in the past.
Logistics is a significant problem globally, including for the Middle East.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "As of now, see, there are challenges in terms of logistics if we talk about right now for Middle East. In fact, for the entire world right now logistics is a very big problem, but that is a part of the business." (concall transcript - 2026-07-01)

threats.point: Supreme Court observations and environment clearance requirements from the Ministry of Environment in Delhi caused a delay in the plant commissioning.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Actually, in last year, maybe October, November, there was some Supreme Court observation in this area -- clarification, we need to have to meet EC, environment clearance. So then we applied that environment clearance to MOF, Ministry of Environment Delhi, as..." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Raw material commodity prices have increased for companies due to supplies coming from the Middle East market.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "See, the things, the raw material commodity prices have increased for each and every company, not only laminates, we talk about any company, any product due to this, all the supply are coming from Middle East market." (concall transcript - 2026-05-01)

threats.point: Historically weak quarters (Mar, Jun, Dec) are still in the cycle.

swot.verdict: Strengths dominate the evidence (S31/W18/O29/T10), led by 'Capital efficiency is high - the business earns well above a normal cost of capital', with 57 points of weight still sitting on the weakness, opportunity and threat side.
